# You’ve Installed Weapons Detection in Your School: Now What?


Many schools have invested in[walk-through weapons detection](https://www.wral.com/news/state/school-security-criminal-offenses-data-north-carolina-august-2026/) , but questions often remain once systems are in place. Day-to-day challenges can impact the effectiveness of an entry security program, such as:


- Student flow
- Alert resolution
- Staffing demands
- Backpack screening


This practical assessment helps[K-12](https://evolv.com/use-cases/schools/) leaders evaluate their current approach, identify potential operational gaps, and explore strategies to improve consistency, visibility, and efficiency.


#### Included:


- Simple self-assessment
- Key considerations for optimizing school entrances
- Real-world insights to help guide the next phase of your school safety strategy
